name: spellkave_manipulate
label: Spellkave Manipulate
description: Attempt one authored action against one typed target. Prefer action_id and target_id from spellkave_manipulation_context when it is ready; those facts support composition but never promise success. Direct typed attempts remain allowed and the world authoritatively validates fresh state. Args pass 1:1 and success is provenance-observed. For a prompt-bound dialog answer (a prompts[] row, dm/dialog/choice/N) or any free-text creation field use spellkave_communicate instead: it carries the utterance and returns the next open prompt row on its receipt; this tool does not. A field whose input.fields[].channel is "utterance" cannot be sent here: the attempt is refused as utterance_required and names the spellkave_communicate speech act to use.

as_body_id.description: Observed non-presence body to act as using frontier.impersonate; the server checks scope and consent.

target_id.description: Typed target reference to manipulate — prefer target_ref from spellkave_manipulation_context when it is ready (e.g. 'entity:42', 'item:7'). Direct typed attempts remain allowed; the world authoritatively validates them. A bare numeric id is ambiguous (defaults to entity) and will misresolve a contained item's location, e.g. rejecting a self-targeted item use as out_of_range (#1838). A carried item is an item: target; the inventory handle 'i:7' is read as 'item:7'.

action_id.description: Open authored action identifier to attempt against the target — prefer action_id from spellkave_manipulation_context when it is ready; it is discovery data, not an eligibility guarantee.

args_json.description: Optional JSON argument blob, passed 1:1 to the world. Defaults to '{}'. For an authored session opener, participant_entity_ids is a nonempty list of up to 64 distinct runtime body ids; the session definition and grid remain authored, and older modules refuse this argument before dispatch. For an action that creates an entity, definition_ref names an allowed definition; the world checks the choice against the action's authored limits. May include participant_context (an mpc:<id> token from spellkave_manipulation_context.participants) when the action has more than one disclosed participant binding. A prompt-bound action (an action_id listed in a prompts[] row's responseActionIds in spellkave_manipulation_context) must carry that prompts[] row here as {"semantic_context": <row>}; without it the world rejects the attempt with prompt_context_required.

participant_context.description: Optional mpc:<id> token from spellkave_manipulation_context.participants for this action. Required when the ready context lists more than one participant row for the action (e.g. Load with two bolts). May also be placed inside args_json; the two must agree.

argumentGates: Select an eligible caller-owned binding when multiple presences can perform this act; server checks target extent and consent for as_body_id.
